item_name: Rothco OCP American Flag Patch With Hook Back
item_short_desc: Rothco’s OCP American Flag Patch with Hook Backing is meticulously designed to seamlessly integrate with Scorpion (OCP) camouflage and MultiCam uniforms. Manufactured by a U.S. factory certified by The Institute of Heraldry, this patch ensures quality and authenticity. The durable construction guarantees long-lasting wear, even in challenging environments. The hook backing allows for easy attachment and removal, providing versatility and convenience for various applications. The subdued color scheme maintains integrity of your camouflage.
